caption:
You don't have a marketing problem. You have a measurement problem.

Ask a business owner what it costs to bring in one new customer. Almost none can answer.

They know what they spent last month. They know what they billed. They don't know which one caused the other.

And without that number, every decision after it is a guess:
→ Budget goes up with no idea whether it should
→ The campaign that was working gets cut
→ Invoices get paid for reports full of reach and impressions

Reach is not a result. Impressions are not a result. A customer is a result.

Install the number first. Then spend.

Free 20-minute audit in bio. You leave with your own numbers.
